plan.scope: Standalone native REP, loan and registry E2E fixture. No production adapter or UI acceptance.
plan.accounts: Four fresh faucet-funded test accounts, independent of Vedant's POC
plan.assets: Own test USD MPT and separate nontransferable REP MPT
plan.signing: Fixture-only exact-action gate, borrower and broker signatures, no Vedant keys
plan.persistence: Private wallets and signed attempts in ignored data/run-id with restricted permissions

acceptance_boundary: Fresh native REP issuance/redemption/return, native LoanSet/LoanPay, exact fixture signing gate and Gita registry. Lender underwriting, production mandate verification, Vedant adapter and UI remain outside this check.
